settings.title: Delivery & Returns
settings.content: Free standard UK delivery (2–4 working days). Next-day delivery available at checkout. Not for you? Return it within 30 days for a full refund.

settings.title: About The Packs
settings.content: One Blamp is £19.99. Two are £29.99 and three are £34.99, so a three pack works out at under £12 each. Choose your pack with the hearts and the price updates before you add to bag.

settings.title: Charge it, clip it on
settings.text: A 90-minute USB-C charge gives you up to 10 hours of light. Clip the lobster clasp to a handbag, clutch, backpack, keys or a pet collar.

settings.title: Tap once to light
settings.text: One tap turns it on or off. Hold for 16 seconds to keep it lit, and tap through three brightness levels.

settings.title: See everything, inside and out
settings.text: Find your keys at the bottom of your bag, light the lock at the front door, or unclip it and carry it for the walk home.
